title: Le Pen Is Misinformed, Sheinbaum Says; “The ‘Mexicanization’ Is the Honesty and Solidarity of the People,” She Asserts
author: Alma E. Muñoz and Alonso Urrutia
content:
_This article by[Alma E. Muñoz and Alonso
Urrutia](https://www.jornada.com.mx/autores/Alma%20E.%20Mu%C3%B1oz%20y%20Alonso%20Urrutia)
originally appeared in the [October 28, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/28/politica/le-pen-esta-
malinformada-dice-sheinbaum-la-mexicanizacion-es-la-honestidad-y-solidaridad-
del-pueblo-de-mexico-asegura), Mexico's premier left wing daily newspaper._

**Mexico City**. President Claudia Sheinbaum Pardo asserted that far-right
leader Marine Le Pen "**is misinformed** ," after she stated that she will not
allow the [Mexicanization of
France](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/26/mundo/le-pen-arranca-su-
campana-en-francia-va-contra-migrantes-y-la-mexicanizacion) through the
presence of drug cartels.

> She is misinformed, because the Mexicanization that should reach the whole
> world is that of the values of the people of Mexico, of honesty, of love, of
> solidarity, of fraternity, which are badly needed today throughout the
> entire world.
>
> President Claudia Sheinbaum, at her press conference

In her campaign launch, Le Pen also offered **mass deportation of undocumented
migrants**.

On another subject, she declined to comment on the [flight of Brazil's Flávio
Bolsonaro to the United
States](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/10/27/mundo/estados-unidos-
afirma-que-concedera-visados-a-flavio-bolsonaro-y-su-familia-segun-fuente-
diplomatica). "It explains itself," she said.

The senator fled Brazil yesterday, after losing Sunday's presidential
elections, at the same time that the government of President Donald Trump
announced that it will grant visas to the **former far-right candidate and his
family**.
